b: Don’t put away your fishing gear just yet! Idaho Fish and Game plans to stock more than 60,000 catchable-sized rainbow trout in lakes and ponds across the state this November.
Whether you’re looking for a quick fishing trip close to home or a new place to cast a line, check out this month’s stocking highlights.
Great Fishing Doesn’t End When Temperatures Drop
Cooler temperatures may keep some anglers indoors, but trout and whitefish remain active in Idaho’s rivers and streams throughout late fall and winter.
